reason: #421 item 1: the router's `blocked` search (a connection whose port another node covers) gets a finite expansion budget, BLOCKED_EXPANSIONS (200,000, the outer corridor's); a search that reaches it draws the direct line from end to end, as an end node sealed in already did. On the measured ~100-node graph (the MMO template with four blocked routes) the searches took at most 13,917 expansions, so no route changed and the drawing is the same; the budget only bounds a much larger graph.
